description: This file contains a test runner class 'ClientStreamTestRunner' implementing various streaming-related test methods using Orleans testing framework, involving stream producer and consumer simulations, client drop and re-initialization scenarios.

classes.name: ClientStreamTestRunner
classes.description: A class providing methods to run streaming tests, including handling client drop and recovery scenarios in Orleans streaming environment.

methods.name: StreamProducerOnDroppedClientTest
methods.description: Tests stream producing consistency after client drop and re-initialization.

methods.name: StreamConsumerOnDroppedClientTest
methods.description: Tests stream consumer behavior and message delivery after client drop, including retry delays and failure count checks.

methods.name: SubscribeToStream
methods.description: Subscribes to a specified stream with a callback for incoming messages.

methods.name: ProduceEventsFromClient
methods.description: Produces a set number of events to a specified stream after subscribing as a consumer.

methods.name: GenerateEvents
methods.description: Sends a sequence of events to a stream as an observer.

methods.name: CheckCounters
methods.description: Verifies that the number of consumed events matches the number of produced events, asserting equality.
